verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers card issuing, spend controls, ledger, disputes, webhooks, and agentic card provisioning, but there is no mention of network tokens, tokenized digital cards' token-level management, wallet/merchant token association, or ability to revoke a token independently of the PAN. missing for 10: network token visibility/management APIs, wallet/merchant identification for tokens, token-level revocation separate from card cancellation.
